entities.summary: Nicole A. Avant is an American diplomat, producer, and political activist who served as the United States ambassador to the Bahamas from 2009 to 2011. She is a member of the Democratic Party. Nicole Avant was a political leaders from Los Angeles County (b. 1968-03-06, Los Angeles County). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.
